conversion: Decoded with FFmpeg to mono 44100 Hz signed 16-bit PCM WAV; no content processing was applied to the bundled files. Silence splitting, trimming, retuning, filtering, and layering happen at render time.
verification: Each license was read from its OpenGameArt source page. HaelDB offers the collection under both OGA-BY 3.0 and CC0; this project uses the explicit CC0 option.

collections.name: Male Grunt/Yelling sounds
collections.author: HaelDB
collections.selection: Six files explicitly named grunt were selected from the 63-file, four-performer archive. Files named yell were excluded because the target cues require brief nonverbal effort and explicitly exclude screams.

collections.name: Female Hurt Grunts & Groans
collections.author: Nocturnal_Vanguard / AuraVoice
collections.selection: The source is a 13-second reel of isolated performances. Render-time activity detection selects one utterance rather than treating the reel as a single cue.
